shortDescription: Manage SAN Connectivity Policies and vHBAs for Cisco Intersight

options.name: api_bearer_token
options.description: Bearer token for OAuth2 authentication with the Intersight API. When provided, I(api_key_id) and I(api_private_key) are not required and the C(cryptography) Python library is not needed. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_BEARER_TOKEN environment variable is used.

options.name: api_key_id
options.description: Public API Key ID associated with the private key. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_KEY_ID environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not provided.

options.name: api_private_key
options.description: Filename (absolute path) or string of PEM formatted private key data to be used for Intersight API authentication. If a string is used, Ansible vault should be used to encrypt string data. Ex. ansible-vault encrypt_string --vault-id tme@/Users/dsoper/Documents/vault_password_file '-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----     <your private key data>     -----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----' If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not

options.name: api_uri
options.description: URI used to access the Intersight API. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_URI environment variable is used.

options.name: description
options.description: The user-defined description for the SAN Connectivity Policy. Description can contain letters(a-z, A-Z), numbers(0-9), hyphen(-), period(.), colon(:), or an underscore(_).

options.name: name
options.description: The name assigned to the SAN Connectivity Policy. Must be unique within the organization. The name must be between 1 and 64 alphanumeric characters, allowing special characters :-_.

options.name: organization
options.description: The name of the Organization this resource is assigned to. Policies created within a Custom Organization are applicable only to devices in the same Organization. Use 'default' for the default organization.

options.name: placement_mode
options.description: The mode used for placement of vHBAs on network adapters. C(custom) requires manual placement specification for each vHBA. C(auto) automatically distributes vHBAs between adapters during profile deployment. Only applicable for FIAttached target platform.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify the resource is present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify the resource is absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: static_wwnn_address
options.description: The WWNN address for the server node must be in hexadecimal format xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx. Allowed ranges are 20:00:00:00:00:00:00:00 to 20:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF or from 50:00:00:00:00:00:00:00 to 5F:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF. To ensure uniqueness of WWN's in the SAN fabric, you are strongly encouraged to use the WWN prefix - 20:00:00:25:B5:xx:xx:xx. Required when wwnn_address_type is static and target platform is FIAttached. Only applicable for FIAttached target platform.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags in Key:<user-defined key> Value:<user-defined value> format.

options.name: target_platform
options.description: The platform type for which the SAN Connectivity policy is intended. C(Standalone) for Standalone servers. C(FIAttached) for fabric interconnect attached servers. Note SAN Connectivity policies are not supported on unified edge servers.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean control for verifying the api_uri TLS certificate

options.name: vhbas
options.description: List of vHBAs to be created and attached to the SAN Connectivity policy. Each vHBA will be configured with the specified fibre channel policies. Configuration options vary based on target_platform.

options.name: wwnn_address_type
options.description: Type of WWNN address assignment. C(pool) to use a WWNN pool. C(static) to manually assign a static WWNN address. Only applicable when target_platform is FIAttached.

options.name: wwnn_pool
options.description: The WWNN pool that is assigned for WWNN address assignment. Required when wwnn_address_type is pool and target platform is FIAttached. Only applicable for FIAttached target platform.
